comments.text: Codex branch aa-27x/responsive-smell-path is now at 34f8d73. The implementation evolved from the original SVG: it uses CSS-only <picture> selection with three project-local bitmap variants at mobile <=560px, tablet <=900px, and desktop fallback for a carvone receptor/percept illustration, plus a second three-variant configural-odor illustration (ethyl isobutyrate + ethyl maltol at the studied 30:70 ratio -> pineapple-like percept). Both figures have live alt/caption text; python gen_mirrors.py was run after each index.html edit. Browser checks at 360, 768, and 1100px selected the intended assets with no horizontal overflow. The branch remains based on the older main noted in this ticket: do not merge raw; splice/rebase onto current main and rerun the current mirror generator before landing.

Maintainer-side review checklist, updated for the evolved implementation (bitmaps, two figures): (1) SCOPE — the task authorized one figure for the smell-path paragraph; the second figure (configural odor: ethyl isobutyrate + ethyl maltol 30:70 -> pineapple-like percept) names compounds and cites a studied ratio, so before landing, verify the study behind 30:70 and confirm the figure attaches to the configural-perception paragraph (flavorants section), not the smell-path one. (2) BITMAPS — check total added page weight for 6 assets, sharpness at 2x DPR, and that backgrounds sit correctly on the cream paper (transparent or #f8eed9-matched); house style is flat editorial. (3) TRIPWIRE AMENDED — effective diff may now touch index.html + regenerated mirrors + the new project-local image assets, nothing else. (4) Splice/rebase onto current main and rerun the CURRENT gen_mirrors.py; confirm both captions and alt text reach the mirrors. (5) Verify no third-party requests were introduced.

MAINTAINER REVIEW of 34f8d73 (full review relayed via Denson). Verdict: strong design direction, not landable yet. CITATIONS VERIFIED: Pike/Enns/Hornung 1988 Chem Senses 13(2):307 supports carvone both-qualities claim (humans) - but is not cited on-page, add it. JEB 10.1242/jeb.242274 is Coureaud, Thomas-Danguin, Sandoz & Wilson 2022 (review) - page cites it as 'Thomas-Danguin et al.' = wrong first author; fix to Coureaud et al. 2022, ideally also credit Le Berre et al. 2008 as the original EI/EM 30:70 pineapple finding (humans). IMAGE ERRORS (must fix): (1) smell-path glyphs are unrelated shapes while the annotation says mirror-image - carvone enantiomers must be mirrored glyphs; (2) configural image shows the two molecules merging into a NEW maroon molecule that docks one receptor = illustrates chemical combination, but configural perception is neural - molecules must dock separately, the BRAIN renders the new percept. STRUCTURE: do not edit the approved pivot paragraph (restore 'spearmint or skunk' wording and the aromatherapy parenthetical position - it is currently orphaned after the second figure); the configural h3+figure belongs in the flavorants section next to the existing configural-perception paragraph, not in the hinge. WEIGHT: 9MB PNG is too heavy; recommendation is redraw as inline SVG using these bitmaps as the design spec (house precedent = dementia timeline SVG; ~10KB, crisp at all DPR, editable); if bitmaps kept: WebP, total <500KB, and per-source width/height (mobile asset is 864x1821 vs declared 1536x1024 = layout shift). TRANSPLANT: do not rebase; re-implement on a fresh branch off current main incorporating this review; rerun current gen_mirrors.py (base's generator predates the callout/b-boundary fixes). Ticket stays open.
